text: OVERDOSAGE: Accidental ingestion of large amounts of fluoride can result in acute irritation of the mouth and gastrointestinal tract as well as the development of gastrointestinal symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, hematemesis epigastric cramping and abdominal pain. If a large amount of fluoride equal to or greater than 5 mg fluoride/kg body weight (2.3 mg fluoride/lb body weight) is ingested, give calcium (e.g. milk, 5% calcium gluconate or calcium solution) orally to relieve gastrointestinal symptoms and admit immediately to a hospital facility. A standard treatment dose of Neutra-Foam contains approximately 9.0mg fluoride. One 165 g (5.8 oz) bottle contains approximately 1.43 g of fluoride.
